title: Lockstep pin reads a hardcoded copy, never the production terminal_statuses const
evidence:
pub fn terminal_statuses_lockstep_with_shared_truth_test() {
  let terminal = [
    "form_completed",
    "manual_recorded",
    "unreachable",
    "refused",
    "objected",
    "partial",
    "failed",
    "completed",
  ]
---
const terminal_statuses: List(String) = [
  "form_completed",
  "manual_recorded",
  "unreachable",
  "refused",
  "objected",
  "partial",
  "failed",
  // v2-reserved voice terminal — harmless to include.
  "completed",
]
detail: Test re-declares the list instead of iterating the handler's const (private, unreachable), so editing terminal_statuses fails no test. Timeline terminal entries (const) can drift from hooks (shared fn) undetected — the divergence class AR-RC13 guards.
recommended_fix: Export the const (or a pub accessor) from the handler; iterate it in the lockstep test so const edits are test-visible.

title: Hooks lint evadable by list position: [RefcheckTakeOver, RefcheckSkip] passes CI
evidence:
# construction shape only: identifier immediately followed by `]`
            marker = action + "]"
            if marker not in line:
                continue
detail: Marker matches a governed action only as the FINAL list element. Sandbox-verified: a status-derived `[RefcheckTakeOver, RefcheckSkip]` exits 0 (lint clean). The RC4.3-r1 shape is caught only because its last element was itself governed — reordering the tail defeats the guard.
recommended_fix: Match governed constructors anywhere within list brackets, and add a CI negative-control fixture feeding the historical shapes to the lint itself.

title: trigger.gleam keeps an unpinned third terminality list; 'one home' claim doesn't hold
evidence:
fn is_terminal(status: String) -> Bool {
  list.contains(
    [
      "form_completed",
      "unreachable",
      "refused",
      "objected",
      "manual_recorded",
      "failed",
      "completed",
      "partial",
    ],
    status,
  )
}
detail: This pre-existing string list drives find_live_row_for_slot (substitute path). No new pin — truth table, lockstep, lint — reaches it; a new terminal status in shared would silently diverge here. The amendment's 'terminality has ONE home' is untested against this list.
recommended_fix: Convert trigger.is_terminal to consume shared status_from_string + is_terminal_status, or add a pin iterating this list against the shared fn.

title: outcome_from_string_optional's 15-arm mapping pinned for only two known values
detail: every_outcome_round_trips_test pins only outcome_from_string; the new wire mapper duplicates its 15 arms but is pinned for two values. An outcome added to one mapping and not the other ships silently.
recommended_fix: Add a pin: each all_outcomes() entry |> encode_outcome |> outcome_from_string_optional should equal Some(outcome).
